example.title: Cedarburg Mill, 215 East Columbia Avenue
example.source: HABS WI-154 (photos via Wikimedia Commons mirror of HABS WIS,45-CEDBU,1-)

brief: Large water-powered flour mill of 1855 on Cedar Creek: a five-storey block of coursed rubble limestone under a steep gable roof with a long row of small roof windows, regular rows of small-paned windows with stone lintels, a lower gabled stone wing to one side and a shed-roofed loading canopy along the street front. Beside it a small gas station, the creek and dam behind.
